html: אוב (meaning? Thes comp. Arabic آبَ return, whence KöOff.-begr. ii 15 C StaG i.504; Bib. Theol. i. 186 NowArch. ii. 273 as rediens, “revenant”; but doubtful. أَيَّابٌ water-carrier; but cf. LagBN 90). MV comp. אבב (with conjectural sense) to get meaning have a hollow sound. Deriv. and signif. totally uncertain).*
